name: jt-card-bench
description: 3D hardware-in-the-loop simulator for an RP2350 business card: runs real Pico SDK firmware against a model of the circuit built from its KiCad files

scripts.build: node tools/build-firmware.mjs firmware/fluid-demo -o dist/fluid-demo.wasm && node tools/build-firmware.mjs firmware/maze-demo firmware/fluid-demo/charlieplex.c firmware/fluid-demo/lis2dh12.c -o dist/maze-demo.wasm && node tools/build-firmware.mjs firmware/examples/common-mistakes -o dist/common-mistakes.wasm
scripts.extract: python3 tools/kicad_pcb_extract.py board/JT-Business-Card.kicad_pcb -o board/board.json --header firmware/fluid-demo/led_map.h && python3 tools/kicad_artwork.py board/JT-Business-Card.kicad_pcb -o board/artwork.json

author: Trammell Montgomery
